label: VERIFIED
extraction: MCP Registry About: Official centralized metadata repository for publicly accessible MCP servers. Backed by Anthropic, GitHub, PulseMCP, Microsoft. Provides: single place for server metadata publishing, namespace management via DNS verification, REST API for client discovery, standardized installation/config info. Server metadata in server.json: unique name (reverse DNS: io.github.user/server), location (npm package, remote URL), execution instructions (CLI args, env vars), discovery data (description, capabilities). No private servers (private network/registries). Namespace auth via reverse DNS tied to verified GitHub accounts/domains. Moderation: automated scanning, manual takedown.
